question: Why is the mass of reality also called an egg?
premises: The mass of reality partakes of the collectivity of Shiva and Shakti.
In its manifestation there is a turning toward.
That turning toward explains the designation egg.
inference: Therefore the manifested mass of reality is called an egg because it turns toward manifestation as a unified Shiva-Shakti collectivity.
uncertainties: The compound śivaśaktisamūhabhāk could also be read more loosely as participating in their totality.
plain_english: The mass of reality is said to partake of the collectivity of Shiva and Shakti, and because it turns toward manifestation it is called an egg.
